basic_info.description: Discover classic SF charm at 452 Chenery Street! Cheerful 1920s single-family gem nestled in Glen Park combines timeless architectural details with modern updates. Prime walkable location - steps to cafes, bakeries, shops, restaurants, & all the treasures of Glen Park Village! Featuring an updated chef's kitchen w/ top-tier appliances, including a Viking gas range, Miele DW, beautiful new refrigerator & flooring, an abundance of cabinets, shelving, & a generous pantry for all your cooking & entertaining dreams. Light-filled living & dining rooms w/ classic details, including decorative wainscoting, a cozy fireplace, & built-in library shelves provide a delightful setting for holiday gatherings & celebrations. Hardwood floors throughout the main living spaces bestow added warmth. Expansive private yard & terraced deck, perfect for BBQs, frolicking w/ furry friends, & lounging in the sun. 2 spacious & serene bedrooms ideally situated at the back of the home. Bright & well-appointed bathroom w/ Jacuzzi tub & shower. Attached garage w/ laundry & ample storage space. New furnace & light fixtures bring additional modern details & comforts to this inviting home. Easy access to shopping, dining, parks, schools, freeways, & transit. Enjoy the best of SF living in this stylish urban oasis!
